When the zombies approach, you have to defend yourself! Don't want to blindly await death? Call up your school girls! Over 30 million players across the globe are waiting to play with you! The war has just begun...

【Storyline】
After a massive attack, the world has befallen to a disaster in which zombies spread all over it. The last human beings are stuck inside the ruins of a school, and you are their commander. Here, you can collect and train beautiful young girls with different talents to be your personal zombie killers. They’re ready to eliminate zombies outside the school for you. A huge wave of zombies is coming and you’re the last hope of saving the earth and mankind!
 
【Features】
• The crazy storyline of this game will suck you in
• Collect and train numerous Zgirls to be your zombie killers
• Upgrade your base to resist all kinds of raids from zombies and foes
• Manufacture ultimate equipment to support your forces even better
• Abundant quests and events help you quickly develop
• Play with friends or foes among players from all over the world
• Face and take down terrifying zombies. Go, Zgirls!

Welcome to Zombieville USA!

When your town is overrun by the walking dead, there's only one thing left to do - go through their pockets and look for loose change!  As the lone survivor of a zombie apocalypse, it's up to you to battle legions of the undead in a never ending fight for survival!  How long can you hold out?  Scrounge for cash and ammunition, and employ a variety of weapons as your inevitable doom closes in around you...

Zombieville USA combines the timeless appeal of classic arcade games with stunning graphics and animation!

LITE VERSION FEATURES:
- A couple levels of light-hearted zombie slaying!  Check out the full version of Zombieville USA for the complete survival mode, different difficulty choices, high scores, 15 different weapons/upgrades, multiple zombie types and more!

Be sure to check out the eye-popping trailer at www.zombievilleusa.com!

Defend your house from hordes of zombies. Survive, build a time machine, and save humanity. Pixel Combat: Zombies Strike is a pixel first-person zombie shooter with wave battles, shelter defense, and base survival.

Fight through wave after wave, board up the house, place barricades, defend your shelter, and search for resources. Aim fast, move smart, and use the right weapon in every fight. If you like zombie games, action shooters, FPS combat, and survival under siege, get ready for nonstop attacks, dangerous enemies, and intense boss fights.

Explore 40+ 3D locations, complete 110+ missions, and find 120+ secrets and hidden rooms. Every level pushes you to fight harder and play smarter. Enemies grow stronger, bosses use special abilities, and you must change position, manage resources, and hold your base.

Use 60+ weapons to stop the undead horde. Fight with knives, axes, pistols, rifles, shotguns, machine guns, a flamethrower, a minigun, and more. Craft weapons and ammo, strengthen your defenses, and prepare for the next attack.

Secret rooms, rare resources, and rewards help you survive longer and move closer to your goal. Step by step, collect what you need to build a time machine and save the world.

Game Features:

- Pixel first-person zombie shooter with 110+ missions full of action, survival, and intense combat
- House defense and shelter survival against undead waves
- Barricades, base defense, and survival tactics across 40+ 3D battle locations
- 120+ secrets and hidden rooms for players who explore every level
- Boss fights and monsters with special abilities that make every battle more dangerous
- Craft weapons and ammo, use 60+ weapons, and unlock 150+ weapon skins
- Black Ops-inspired zombie action in a pixel world
- Minecraft-style characters and blocky skins, plus 20+ skins for your character
- A time machine story about saving humanity and 80+ achievements to complete

Install Pixel Combat: Zombies Strike, shoot zombies, survive the waves, defend your shelter, complete missions, collect weapons, hold your base, and save humanity in this zombie FPS shooter.

The app offers an auto-renewing subscription, “VIP Gold Status,” which gives players extra rewards without ads. Subscription duration: 1 week.

That zombie apocalypse you’ve always wanted to bring about is finally a thing!

Graft and stitch together different mutant zombies and create an undead horde to call yours! 

Each and every one of them will be a unique shambling corpse with hopes and dreams and a healthy appetite for human brains!

And they’re very low-maintenance, too, what with their favorite dish being so abundant and all.

It’s every necromancer’s dream!

UNDEAD FEATURES

• Pantheon: a new place for supreme beings to look down on us mortals and laugh at our misery
• Impostors: watch out for impostors trying to steal the spotlight from the zombies

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag and drop similar zombies to create new mysterious creatures
• Use zombie eggs to earn coins, buy new creatures and make even more money
• Alternatively, fiercely tap a zombie to make coins pop from their eggs

HIGHLIGHTS
• Different stages and many zombie species to discover
• A mind-blowing story with brain melting twists!
• The unexpected mix of alpaca-like evolution and incremental clicker games
• Doodle-like illustrations
• Various possible endings: find your destiny
• No zombies were harmed in the making of this game, only developers

Now THIS is bio hazard!

Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.
